hero.title: Summary
hero.description: Senior Software Engineer specializing in stabilizing and scaling cloud-native platforms. Delivers production-grade systems in fintech and high-traffic consumer environments. Strong ownership across architecture, infrastructure, observability, and AI integrations—including latency-sensitive inference paths and retrieval-grounded product workflows. Experienced in improving reliability, reducing operational risk, and accelerating delivery in distributed teams.
hero.architectureValue: Microservices/Modular Monoliths, DDD, Clean Code, Clean Arch, Event-Driven Systems, REST/GraphQL/Federation, Kafka
hero.aiValue: Retrieval-grounded LLM workflows, staged evaluator + analyst + pitch, Cursor, Copilot, OpenAI APIs

desc: Designed and delivered an AI-driven warranty claim automation platform that replaced manual support workflows with a scalable JSON-based decision engine integrated with image evaluation models, Salesforce case updates, and chatbot automation.

Owned the engineering link between business, client, infrastructure, security, support, product, and engineering stakeholders in a remote-first delivery model, keeping scope, risks, and integration checkpoints visible through tickets, specs, workshops, and decision logs.

roles.cardDescription:
The production portfolio and recruiter-assistant experience ship from 100% AI-generated application code—authored in Cursor with Copilot in the review loop—while I own architecture, threat modeling, prompts, tests, CI/CD, and AWS operations end to end.

Click this card for the build plan, scope, and what is in production today.
desc: Built and operate my portfolio as a production-grade AI-native software project, using it as both a recruiter-facing profile and a live demonstration of architecture, prompt design, CI/CD, testing, and cloud delivery practices.

Designed an AI Recruiter Assistant that evaluates job descriptions against portfolio evidence using retrieval-grounded workflows, staged evaluator → analyst → pitch generation, streamed responses, capability scoring, and public portfolio content as the source of truth.

Own the full stack: Next.js static export, React, TypeScript, MUI, OpenAI integration, Lambda APIs, S3/CloudFront hosting, GitHub Actions, Playwright, Vitest, accessibility, metadata, and recruiter-facing UX polish.
Use Cursor and Copilot as AI development partners while keeping human ownership over system design, review quality, threat modeling, prompts, test strategy, and production operations.
chips: Assistant: RAG + streamed evaluator → analyst → pitch (Lambda)
roles.tech: Next.js, React, TypeScript, MUI, OpenAI, AWS (S3; CloudFront; Lambda), Vitest, Playwright, GitHub Actions

desc: Led architecture and delivery for BKYC enterprise onboarding, building a performant React Native application, companion web portal, and backend services that enabled the company to onboard large corporate customers and support enterprise subscription use cases for the first time.

Collaborated with UX, product, backend, compliance, and banking integration teams to define scalable onboarding flows for corporate entity data, KYC documents, authority permissions, and real-time validation against Solaris and third-party APIs.

Implemented shared product flows across React Native, React web, and backend services, applying clean architecture, reusable business logic, testing, and CI/CD practices to keep the platform maintainable as requirements evolved.

Built an event-driven billing-invoicing bridge with AWS Lambda, SQS, Node.js, REST APIs, schema validation, idempotency keys, retry handling, CloudWatch dashboards, and alarms—reducing billing-to-invoicing sync latency from hours to under 500ms while keeping processing costs low.

Improved observability across onboarding and financial product workflows with Datadog APM, RUM, custom dashboards, product analytics, and operational playbooks so teams could detect validation errors, integration failures, latency regressions, and user journey friction.
roles.tech: React, React Native, Node.js, TypeScript, Next.js, AWS Lambda, SQS, Terraform, Docker, PostgreSQL, Datadog, Sentry, Jest, REST APIs

desc: Developed and evolved Klarna's transactional email and marketing campaign platform, supporting high-volume, multi-market communication in revenue-critical purchase and lifecycle flows.

Designed and led implementation of a real-time vector decision engine that transformed customer interaction data into embeddings, matched profiles against live campaigns, and retrieved personalized content inside the transactional email pipeline within a ~200ms response window at ~100 RPS.

Built the engine as a containerized Node.js/TypeScript microservice with REST endpoints for on-the-fly content retrieval in purchase-confirmation flows, integrating peer-based recommendation logic through Power User Profiles and live campaign feeds.

Delivered discount-driven campaign integrations by connecting external discount-management systems into the email platform through resilient microservice connectors, Kafka events, personalization rules, and A/B test variants so customers could activate relevant offers directly from their inbox.

Instrumented end-to-end observability with Datadog tracing, custom metrics, latency/error SLOs, and on-call practices for critical communication systems, helping detect integration failures, optimize retry strategies, and protect campaign delivery reliability.

Collaborated across data platform, incentives, content, marketing, analytics, UX, and platform engineering teams through design docs, async RFC-style write-ups, planning sessions, and evidence-based technical discussions.
roles.tech: React, Node.js, TypeScript, Next.js, PostgreSQL, Kafka, REST APIs, Datadog, OpsGenie, Jest, Vector Search, Embeddings

desc: Led architecture and delivery across Brazil and Latin America tax experience initiatives, modernizing seller-facing and backoffice tax workflows across MercadoLivre and MercadoPago with Node.js, React, TypeScript, REST services, observability, and reusable frontend architecture.

Architected and proposed asynchronous system improvements with taxes and billing teams, designing a BFF cached view for seller tax reports that reduced perceived response latency from 1–2s to up to ~200ms while preserving clear cross-team ownership boundaries.

Drove a cross-functional migration from the prior tax-experience ownership model to a new unified tax experience, aligning product, tax policy, UX, backend, mobile, billing, and regional market teams around implementation trade-offs, async patterns, release sequencing, and supportability.

Designed and launched a unified tax-presentation service for Argentine and Uruguayan sellers, exposing REST APIs for React frontends and mobile apps, improving tax transparency, maintaining sub-150ms API response times at peak load, and supporting 99.98% uptime targets.

Built tax exemption and tax breakdown flows for Argentina sellers, including Node.js services, React dashboards, MySQL-backed documentation workflows, lightweight caching, real-time status checks, and compliance-aware collaboration with legal, tax, and UX stakeholders.

Led the design of a unified backoffice experience platform that consolidated multiple internal tools into a single-pane interface, using a React core library, Node.js orchestration layer, shared UI components, service connectors, standardized SCSS theming, and E2E testing to reduce context switching and support errors.

Spearheaded frontend platform foundations for the Brazil Tax Experience team, including a reusable project scaffold, DDD folder guidelines, Webpack/Express development setup, ESLint/TypeScript configuration, Jest and Cypress test templates, Docsify documentation, and Storybook examples that reduced new-project bootstrap time from days to under an hour.

Designed and rolled out a Lerna-managed monorepo for shared UI components, service clients, middleware, and internal tooling, with package boundaries, versioning workflows, Webpack/Rollup builds, TypeScript typings, Jest tests, and documentation that accelerated shared component integration from days to hours.

Led migration of core services, databases, and infrastructure from legacy hosting to the company-standard Fury platform, mapping dependencies, planning cutovers, migrating Java/Groovy/Node.js services, MySQL/Oracle databases, NGINX routing, Elasticsearch clusters, monitoring, logging, and security practices with zero user-facing downtime.
roles.tech: Java, Groovy, React, Node.js, TypeScript, Express, Sass, REST APIs, MySQL, Oracle, Elasticsearch, NGINX, Fury, Lerna, Webpack, Rollup, Jest, Cypress, Datadog, New Relic

desc: Designed and delivered an internal diagnostics and troubleshooting platform for Level 2 and Level 3 support teams, aggregating data from multiple internal and external APIs into a unified diagnostic model that surfaced root-cause hints and workflow health in real time.

Built Node.js/TypeScript services, health-status endpoints, Dockerized deployments, Mesos-based runtime configuration, and Jenkins CI/CD pipelines to automate testing, builds, and releases in a strict operational environment.

Partnered with SRE, application support, and support leadership to refine alert thresholds, document troubleshooting workflows, onboard users, and increase ticket throughput by helping engineers diagnose incidents faster.

Collaborated directly with leadership, consultants, QA, sales, and field specialists to elicit requirements, document validation criteria, model workflows, and translate regulated business processes into full-stack product features.

blocks.title: The Moment I Discovered I Could Build My Own World
blocks.body: I started my journey in technology at 15, when I enrolled in a technical school and had my first informatics classes. I had always loved building things, but that was the moment I realized I could turn this instinct into a profession. With just a computer, I could create systems, solve problems, and build tools that mattered. That discovery shaped the direction of my life.

blocks.title: Choosing the Long Game Over Short-Term Comfort
blocks.body: Inspired by stories of professionals working abroad and building international careers in technology, I enrolled in university at 18 while working full-time as a sales clerk. Eventually, I stepped into my first IT role — even though it paid less than my previous job. Shortly after, I broke my leg and had to keep up with university through additional assignments and remote work, all while earning less and adjusting to a new professional path. It was a difficult period, and I considered giving up. Instead, I chose to commit fully to the long-term vision I had for myself.

blocks.title: Building Foundations That Scale
blocks.body: During university, I developed a strong passion for Data Structures, Algorithms, and Software Engineering. I studied them deeply and intentionally, knowing they would become the foundation of everything I built afterward. While working as an ERP migration trainee in an industrial environment, I completed my graduation project: an educational platform designed to help institutions build and manage courses. That project became the gateway to my first official software engineering role.

blocks.title: From Full-Stack Versatility to International Impact
blocks.body: From there, my career progressed across companies of different sizes and complexities. I worked across the full stack — backend, frontend, infrastructure — taking ownership of challenges regardless of scope. I value versatility, system thinking, and building solutions end to end. Over time, I had the opportunity to contribute to major companies such as Mercado Libre and later Klarna, where I relocated to Europe. That move represented a personal milestone: working internationally, being valued for my craft, and achieving the professional growth I had envisioned years earlier.

blocks.title: Beyond Code: Discipline, Creativity, and Continuous Growth
blocks.body: Beyond engineering, I am driven by curiosity and discipline. I enjoy playing music, training and practicing fitness, and diving into video games. These interests reflect how I approach life: with structure, creativity, and continuous improvement. Whether it's software architecture, a workout routine, or learning a new song, I believe in building things deliberately and pushing them to a higher standard.

blocks.title: Connect
blocks.connectNote: If you'd like to connect about technology, music, fitness, or games, I'm always open to meaningful conversations.
